title: Gassenpfoten
subtitle: The Cats of Tübingen
menu.title: What does {name} get?
zone.head: head
cat.mina.quirk: Sociable and curious. Knows everyone on the Marktplatz.
cat.brezel.quirk: Likes to warm up at the bakery's vent. A little shy.
cat.professor.quirk: Old and dignified. Only lets patient people come close.
toast.controls: WASD/arrows or click: walk · E: feed/pet a cat, talk to people · Shift: sneak · J: cat journal · T: fast-forward time
toast.controls.touch: Tap to walk and tap a cat. Use 🐾 to sneak up quietly.
toast.newCat: New cat spotted: {name}! It's in your cat journal now.
toast.stepBack: Step back a few paces so {name} dares to come to the bowl.
toast.disliked: {name} sniffs and turns away. Not a {item} fan.
toast.fled: {name} got scared and ran off. Approach more slowly (🐾 sneak).
toast.noTreat: No {item} left. Frau Häberle brings more tomorrow morning.
toast.refill: Frau Häberle left some treats on your doorstep. 🧺
toast.petLeft: {name} has had enough and walks away.
toast.content: {name} is content and just wants to doze now.
pet.hint: Press and hold to pet {name}. Watch the body language!
journal.title: 📖 Cat journal
quest.first-friend.title: First friendship
quest.first-friend.find: Find a cat on the Marktplatz.
quest.first-friend.feed: Feed a cat. Put the bowl down and step back.
quest.first-friend.pet: Pet a cat you have fed.
quest.gourmet.title: Gourmet
quest.night-owl.title: The night owl
quest.night-owl.find: People talk about an old cat that sits by the Rathaus arcades in the evening.
toast.locked: The {place} can wait. Get to know the cats here first.
toast.unlocked: New place: {place}! Follow the arrow at the edge.
cat.hoelderlin.quirk: Sits for hours, gazing melancholically at the Neckar.
cat.kahn.quirk: Practically lives on the punts. Sometimes rides along.
quest.river-cats.title: River cats
quest.river-cats.go: Take the southern alley down to the Neckarfront.
quest.river-cats.poet: They say a grey cat sits by the Hölderlinturm, gazing thoughtfully at the water.
quest.river-cats.boat: Feed the cat that lives on the punts.
toast.weather.rain: It starts to rain. The cats look for somewhere dry. 🌧️
toast.weather.fog: Fog rises from the Neckar. You can barely see your hand … 🌫️
cat.lotte.quirk: Three colours and proud of it. When it rains she sits under the arcades and watches the market.
cat.schatten.quirk: All black and very shy. They say she only comes down to the river with the morning fog.
cat.socke.quirk: Grey with white socks. Greets everyone who crosses the bridge.
toast.bande: {name} hisses quietly. The Rote Bande is no joke.
toast.newBande: That's {name} of the Rote Bande. Watch your food!
toast.bandeComing: {name} has smelled the food and comes running!
toast.bandeStole: {thief} stole {name}'s food! Distract the gang first next time.
toast.distracted: {name} pounces on the ball of yarn. That'll keep him busy for a while!
cat.baron.quirk: Huge, orange and full of himself. The boss of the Rote Bande likes your food best.
cat.ruebe.quirk: Baron von Möhre's right paw. Hangs around the Neckar and steals anything that isn't nailed down.
npc.haeberle.greet.0: Grüß Gott! How lovely that you look after the cats.
npc.haeberle.greet.1: Oh, it's you again! Come here, I've got something for you.
npc.haeberle.greet.2: My Brezel was already here this morning. That cat eats me out of house and home.
npc.haeberle.bande: And watch out for the Rote Bande! Baron von Möhre steals every little cat's food. Take these balls of yarn – they keep the rascal busy.
npc.jonas.greet.0: So? Searching for meaning too? Or just for cats?
npc.jonas.greet.1: Hölderlin lived here, you know. That grey cat probably knew him.
npc.jonas.greet.2: I'm writing my thesis. For seven semesters now. Going great.
npc.jonas.schatten: There's an all-black cat around here. Schatten. She only comes when there's morning fog on the Neckar. And she loves catnip.
npc.giftFull: Your bag is full – {item} another time.
npc.hint.where: {name}? You'll often find her here: {spot} ({place}). Best time: {phase}.
npc.hint.only: {name} only shows up in {weather} ({place}). Otherwise she's vanished into thin air.
npc.hint.likes: Do you know what {name} likes best? {item}!
npc.forecast.fog: Smell that? Fog is coming to the Neckar soon. That's when the shadows come out.
quest.meet-haeberle.title: The cat lady
quest.meet-haeberle.talk: Talk to Frau Häberle by the bakery.
quest.bande-trouble.title: Trouble with the Rote Bande
quest.bande-trouble.spot: They say a big red tomcat is terrorising the Marktplatz. Keep an eye out.
quest.bande-trouble.distract: Distract a member of the Rote Bande with a ball of yarn.
quest.fog-cat.title: The fog cat
quest.fog-cat.ask: Ask Jonas at the Neckarmauer about night cats (afternoon to night).
quest.fog-cat.find: Wait for morning fog on the Neckar and find Schatten.
quest.fog-cat.feed: Feed Schatten. She is very shy – sneak up on her.
